messages:
Ethan (sales): Prospect (GlobalTrust) asked for one clear paragraph for their CISO: who owns incident notifications, what timeline we can operationally target if they sign Enterprise terms, and how we hand over logs/artifacts during a POC. Need copy I can paste.

Lina (security): Pasteable paragraph: "Redwood acts as processor for hosted and dedicated deployments and will detect, triage, contain, and remediate incidents on your behalf; the customer remains controller and is responsible for regulator filings and external notifications. For enterprise customers (addendum), our operational targets are: acknowledgement to customer POC within 1 hour for confirmed critical events (24/7 on-call), initial scope & mitigations within 4 hours, containment initiated within 24 hours, and a forensic evidence package within 72 hours for critical incidents (longer for lower severities). Hosted/dedicated log exports are provided via secure transfer within ~48 hours after scope agreement; for Private/VPC installs the customer leads IR and we supply export tools and runbooks per the agreed access plan."

Sam (solutions): Add a one-line SIG/CAIQ alignment: "We map these activities to CAIQ incident controls in the addendum and can attach a short control mapping for your vendor risk team."

Nadia (legal): Legal tweak: add that these are operational targets only unless included in the signed SLA/addendum; Redwood will provide a vendor incident statement and evidence but will not itself submit regulator filings. Also include carve-outs for third-party delays and legal holds.

Ethan (sales): Perfect. I'll send that to the CISO and attach draft addendum + the CAIQ map.

PagerBot: IR playbook (internal): https://redwood.internal/playbooks/incident-response
